name: ypcb_blackwell_like
description: YPCB RV32 compute study with low-precision tensors, block scaling, structured sparsity, shared-memory MMA and asynchronous copies. Not Blackwell ISA emulation.

sources.core: ci/testcases/tensor.yaml, tensor_mx.yaml, tensor_sp_mx.yaml and tensor_wg.yaml; eight threads and eight warps retain a compact study geometry rather than copying RTX 5080 device counts.
sources.platform: Inherits the YPCB CH1 2 GiB ECC, independent 125 MHz clock, TFR DSP inference and five-stage pipeline from ypcb_tcu. Geometry and implementation remain subject to simulation and FPGA qualification.
